name: Cheat
tagline: Play your cards face down and lie with a straight face. Call Cheat! when you smell a bluff.
rulesSummary: Get rid of all your cards. All the cards are dealt, so some players may have one more.
In turn, put 1 to 4 cards face down on the pile and say they're the next rank: aces, twos, threes … kings, then aces again. You must play even with none of that rank. Lying is fine.
Before the next player plays, anyone may press Cheat! The cards are turned up: if any isn't the rank said, the player takes the whole pile; if they were all true, the caller takes it.
After a challenge, play goes on from the left of whoever was challenged, with the next rank.
Play your last cards and anyone may still call Cheat! until the next player plays on or lets you win. Survive that and you win.
Seven or more players: two decks shuffled together, and you may play up to 8 cards at once.
